brief:
Children across Gaza continue to suffer from severe malnutrition following the 2025 famine, Al Jazeera English reported. The region now faces another imminent food emergency, threatening to deepen hardship for a young population already weakened by the earlier crisis and its aftermath.

Health and aid officials warn that the cycle of recurring food shortages poses grave risks to child development and survival rates across Gaza. Many communities have not yet recovered from the previous famine's devastating toll on nutrition and health. The emerging crisis arrives as vulnerable populations remain in urgent need of sustained humanitarian assistance and food aid to prevent further deterioration of conditions for children and families throughout the territory.
dek: Youngsters are still feeling the effects of the 2025 famine, with another food emergency emerging.
title: Famine lingers for Gaza's children as hunger crisis deepens
